# HomeBell API error codes (v1)

Every error response is `application/problem+json` with a machine-readable `code`.
Clients must branch on `code` (never on `detail`) and tolerate unknown codes.

| Code                                | HTTP | Meaning                                                                               | `meta` keys                              |
| ----------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED`                 | 400  | Request body or parameters failed validation; see `errors`.                           |                                          |
| `BAD_REQUEST`                       | 400  | Malformed request.                                                                    |                                          |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED`                   | 401  | Missing or invalid credentials/token.                                                 |                                          |
| `TOKEN_EXPIRED`                     | 401  | Access token expired; refresh and retry.                                              |                                          |
| `SESSION_REVOKED`                   | 401  | Session was revoked (logout elsewhere, transfer, admin action).                       | `reason`                                 |
| `FORBIDDEN`                         | 403  | Caller lacks the required permission.                                                 |                                          |
| `SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT`                | 403  | Session scope (e.g. limited purchase session, read-only support) does not allow this. |                                          |
| `NOT_FOUND`                         | 404  | Resource does not exist or is outside the caller's tenant scope.                      |                                          |
| `CONFLICT`                          | 409  | Generic state conflict.                                                               |                                          |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED`               | 412  | If-Match ETag no longer matches; reload and retry.                                    |                                          |
| `RATE_LIMITED`                      | 429  | Too many requests.                                                                    | `retryAfterSeconds`                      |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`          | 400  | This operation requires an Idempotency-Key header.                                    |                                          |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`            | 422  | Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.                       |                                          |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS`           | 409  | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.                         | `retryAfterSeconds`                      |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`                 | 413  | Request or upload exceeds the size limit.                                             | `maxBytes`                               |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`            | 415  | Unsupported content type.                                                             |                                          |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR`                    | 500  | Unexpected server error; quote traceId to support.                                    |                                          |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`               | 503  | Temporarily unavailable; retry with backoff.                                          | `retryAfterSeconds`                      |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`               | 401  | Email or password is incorrect.                                                       |                                          |
| `MFA_REQUIRED`                      | 401  | MFA step required.                                                                    |                                          |
| `MFA_INVALID`                       | 401  | MFA code invalid.                                                                     | `remainingAttempts`                      |

| `STAFF_INVITATION_INVALID`          | 410  | Staff invitation invalid                                                              |                                          |
